selection.candidate_policy: 50 distinct legal played moves whose reconstructed board is checkmate
selection.control_policy: 20 distinct-source legal no-fires, covering every negative family available in the bounded public population before stable fill

required_checks: the displayed move is legal from the displayed FEN
after the move the opposing king is in check
the opposing side has exactly zero legal replies
the position is checkmate rather than stalemate, resignation or timeout
the proposed copy makes no claim beyond that exact board state
the wording is understandable and useful for a 600-1500 player
the demonstration starts with and legally replays the displayed move
candidate and control membership is not inferred from move notation because check suffixes are removed

promotion_boundary.next_decision: freeze an independent review, reveal sealed membership only after the review is complete, score the Caption gate, then decide promotion
